patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と that comes after a sound or words someone says. It points back to the 'kyuu' in the line before. って　なく = 'it cries (like that)'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end adds a feeling of explaining something; with よ and no だ it sounds feminine. なくのよ = 'it cries, you see!'.
